design: Canonical task -> deterministic context builder -> immutable context packet -> identical packet supplied to paired harnesses (A/B share one packet; C/D share one packet)
context_builder_implementation: source_proxy/context/canonical_broker.py::build_context_broker_report (schema_version 2, ordered manifest, canonical_report_hash). Adapted with a deterministic file-manifest extension for qualification tasks.
determinism_rules: paired lanes receive byte-identical packet (A==B, C==D)
file manifest sorted by POSIX-relative path ascending
complete packet hashed via canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True) + trailing newline
no JCode memory, no previous sessions, no JCode semantic memory may alter the baseline context

context_budget.truncation_policy: tail-truncate file bodies when exceeding max_single_file_bytes; record offset and original size in truncation_receipt; never silently drop required files

fail_closed_conditions: packet cannot be reproduced deterministically across paired harnesses
a required task file is missing or unreadable
context budget exceeded in a way that drops a required file
an excluded path would be included
task_relevant_file_selection: only files in the task's allowed_paths plus explicitly declared shared interface files (e.g., the target module's public contract); selection recorded and hashed
